verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents an official MCP server through which an agent can create indexes, add documents, configure settings and run searches (docs-13, docs-17, docs-57, probe-4). Everything is also exposed through a single API with typed SDKs (docs-1, docs-50, docs-67, docs-68), and agent-readable llms.txt and markdown docs are available (probe-1, probe-2), so no dashboard is needed. A community report that index setup took a week of coding (comm-8) speaks to effort, not inability. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the end-to-end flow, a documented official CLI, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe-3 found all candidate paths 404).
